article.body:
INTERACT paper reports planning method, not vehicle deployment

INTERACT, an autonomous-driving planning method described in an arXiv research paper dated 28 September 2026, has no identified operator, deployment geography or service status and is not evidence of a pilot or commercial operation. The title identifies anchor-conditioned prediction and trust-region refinement as the method’s core elements, but the supplied record does not establish its sensor suite, geofence, road environment, speed limits or other operational-design
